'''Gloomwald's Rage''' is an [[Alpha enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A giant battle puppet created by a Snowpriestess. It had taken its master's command to roam and scour the boundless realm of mist until the moment when it realized that it was abandoned, until it became the vessel bearing the entire rage of a deep snowy forest.}}
